title: Quantum-Assisted Geometric Analysis of Classical Attacks
summary: It remains unknown whether quantum computers can aid geometric analysis of classical cryptanalytic attacks and reveal new cryptanalytic techniques.

formal_statement.body: Determine whether quantum computers can aid the theoretical analysis of classical cryptanalytic attacks using the geometric approach and, in particular, whether such quantum-assisted analysis can reveal new cryptanalytic techniques.

scope.domain: Quantum-assisted geometric analysis of classical cryptanalytic attacks.
scope.unresolved_remainder: Whether quantum assistance can improve the theoretical analysis of classical attacks using the geometric approach and reveal new cryptanalytic techniques.

citations.label: A Geometric Approach to Quantum Distinguishers

progress.summary: The source explicitly presents this as an intriguing open question and identifies the discovery of new cryptanalytic techniques as a possible outcome.
